history.summary: No source found documents a distinct temple called 'Chiplima Temple' at Chiplima/Chipilima, Sambalpur. The only shrine documented at Chipilima in multiple travel and tourism sources is the Maa Ghanteswari Temple (see seq 773), described as the 'Heart of Chipilima'. This CSV row therefore appears to be a duplicate of seq 773 (Maa Ghanteswari Temple, Chipilima) under an abbreviated name - possible but not proven; an alternative is that the row refers to some small unpublicised local shrine at the Chipilima picnic spot, for which nothing could be confirmed online. Recommend: merge this row with 773 or verify on the ground. Do not invent deities, dates or festival details for it. Media intentionally left empty: no reliable image of a distinct 'Chiplima Temple' was found.

name: Chiplima Temple
town_description: Chipilima (Chiplima) is a village and picnic spot in Sambalpur district, western Odisha, on the Mahanadi near the Chipilima Hydro Electric Project, about 25-33 km south-west of Sambalpur city.
